gold.S01: a student who memorized old exam answers looking confused at a new, different exam question
gold.S02: a hiker on a foggy mountain taking huge leaps that overshoot the bottom of the valley and bounce between slopes
gold.S03: a spoon tasting soup from one unstirred corner of a pot, so the taste does not represent the whole pot
gold.S04: a cell drawn as a factory with a power plant inside supplying electricity, representing mitochondria
gold.S05: a student at the movies on a weekend while the wage from a skipped part-time job floats away, opportunity cost
gold.S06: a wall of labeled drawers or lockers where each item is found by its name tag rather than by a number
gold.S07: passengers on a bus lurching forward as the bus suddenly brakes
gold.S08: a student team project where members randomly take turns resting so the team does not depend on one person
gold.S09: a crowded Joseon dynasty civil service examination ground with scholars in traditional robes writing at mats
gold.S10: a book with an overly thick index section, showing that many indexes take space and slow down updates
gold.S11: a spam filter sorting emails, some important normal emails wrongly thrown into the spam bin
gold.S12: the Earth wrapped in a thickening greenhouse gas blanket trapping more heat and getting hotter
